mapper.sql: h.SALE_ID, h.SALE_NO, TO_CHAR( h.BUSINESS_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD' ) AS BUSINESS_DATE, h.BUSINESS_DATE AS SORT_BUSINESS_DATE, h.PARTNER_ID, p.PARTNER_CODE, h.PARTNER_NAME, h.WAREHOUSE_ID, w.WAREHOUSE_CODE, h.WAREHOUSE_NAME, h.ASSIGNEE_ID, a.ASSIGNEE_CODE, h.ASSIGNEE_NAME, h.NOTE, h.PROGRESS_STATUS, h.DELETED_YN, TO_CHAR( h.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR( h.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS' ) AS UPDATED_AT, ( SELECT MIN(l.ITEM_NAME) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK FIRST ORDER BY l.SALE_LINE_ID ) || CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN ' ほか ' || TO_CHAR(COUNT(*) - 1) || '件' ELSE '' END FROM SALE_LINE l WHERE l.SALE_ID = h.SALE_ID AND l.DELETED_YN = 'N' ) AS ITEM_SUMMARY, ( SELECT NVL( SUM(l.TOTAL_AMOUNT), 0 ) FROM SALE_LINE l WHERE l.SALE_ID = h.SALE_ID AND l.DELETED_YN = 'N' ) AS TOTAL_AMOUNT
FROM SALE h LEFT JOIN BIZ_PARTNER p ON p.PARTNER_ID = h.PARTNER_ID LEFT JOIN WAREHOUSE w ON w.WAREHOUSE_ID = h.WAREHOUSE_ID LEFT JOIN ASSIGNEE a ON a.ASSIGNEE_ID = h.ASSIGNEE_ID

WHERE h.DELETED_YN = 'N'
